title: El Alebrije de Tilcajete, VISTA STORIES
comment: alebrije-tilcajete (VISTA): taller de alebrijes en San Martín Tilcajete, Oaxaca. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.CRISPIN_MENDOZA: Indigenous Zapotec Mexican man from Oaxaca, wood carver, 68 years old, brown skin, short grey hair, grey stubble, round wire glasses, a white cotton shirt, a brown work apron with wood shavings, dark trousers, leather sandals, his hands empty.
chars.PAULINA_ARRIAGA: Mexican businesswoman, 40 years old, light skin, a sleek black bob haircut, red lipstick, a red blazer over a white blouse, black trousers, black stilettos, holding a black leather folder.
chars.EZEQUIEL_MENDOZA: Mexican man from Oaxaca, 42 years old, brown skin, short black slicked-back hair, a short black beard, a black dress shirt open at the collar under a black blazer, a gold watch, black trousers, black shoes, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_TALLERALEBRIJE: Patio of a family alebrije workshop in San Martín Tilcajete, Oaxaca, in the afternoon: wooden tables full of colorful painted fantastical wooden animal figures, pieces of raw wood, small paint pots and brushes, adobe walls with pink bougainvillea, agave plants and dry hills beyond, a dirt road, warm sunlight, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
